nodes.label: ADR 0138: What the user asks for goes first
nodes.rationale: Background requests to GLUE Home cache gated at 3 concurrent, playing prioritized over analysis (max 2 during playback), songs read whole from local link in 1MB steps instead of 4MB pieces through Tauri

nodes.label: Gate: Background Request Throttling
nodes.rationale: src/lib/gate.ts limits concurrent cache requests to 3, covering analyses results, spectrograms, waveforms, details; song page requests go first

nodes.label: Playing Priority in GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: While song read for playing in last 10 seconds, no new analysis starts beyond 2 running; read-for-playing means this computer's page on local link or another device streaming

nodes.label: Whole Song Reading from Local Link
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home reads analysis songs whole from /home/file in 1MB steps (network folder gets 47-74 MB/s vs 10 MB/s piecemeal), one request, one open file

nodes.label: Status Poll Throttling
nodes.rationale: engineClient.refresh runs one at a time (not restarting until previous answer)
